body.condition: \(\|\widetilde T_a(P')-\widetilde T_a(P)\|_{\mathrm{op}}\to0\) as \(P'\to P\) in Hellinger distance for \(a=0,1\).

novel.justification: This fixed-coordinate continuity holds for positive finite-proxy charts and for conditional finite-matrix models with continuously varying cell laws; it permits moving marginal Hilbert spaces without selecting a bridge.
